info.title: SHAPI advisory openai-gpt-4o-gpt-4-1-snapshots-shutdown-2027-01-14
info.summary: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1 and gpt-4.1-mini snapshots shut down on 2027-01-14

workflows.summary: Shows the change: OpenAI shuts down gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-4o-2024-11-20, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 and gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 on 2027-01-14, and fine-tunes of these models follow the same date. Only calls that send one of these models are hit. The notice lists dated snapshots and does not say what happens to the undated gpt-4o or gpt-4o-mini aliases.

steps.description: POST /v1/chat/completions fails from 2027-01-14 when the body sends model = gpt-4o-2024-08-06
